verdict.rationale: Clerk's site explicitly states it manages 'the full session lifecycle, including critical security functionality like active device monitoring and session revocation,' with per-device 'Sign out of device' shown in the user profile UI, which covers end-user self-service device management. However, evidence for an admin-facing view/revoke-all-sessions workflow (as opposed to the end-user's own profile) is thin—no dedicated admin dashboard bulk-revoke or per-user admin session management is documented. missing for 10: explicit admin console showing all users' active sessions/devices, a documented 'revoke all sessions at once' bulk action, and independent/hands-on confirmation of revocation actually working.
